name: melta-ds-mcp
description: melta UI — AI-Ready Design System with MCP server (design tokens, component contracts, prohibition rules, check_html self-verification)

scripts.generate: tsx tools/generate-css.ts && tsx tools/generate-tailwind.ts && tsx tools/generate-pen-variables.ts
scripts.design:build: tsx scripts/design/build-legacy.ts && tsx scripts/design/export-recipes.ts && tsx scripts/design/export-designmd.ts && tsx scripts/design/export-dtcg.ts && tsx scripts/design/build-llms-txt.ts && tsc
scripts.postversion: tsx scripts/design/update-showcase.ts && tsx scripts/design/build-llms-txt.ts && git add docs/index.html llms.txt llms-full.txt
scripts.site:build: rm -rf site-public && mkdir -p site-public/docs site-public/scripts site-public/examples site-public/assets site-public/verification && cp docs/index.html docs/icons.html docs/meltan-bounce.html docs/og-image.png docs/Meltan.svg docs/Meltan_favicon.svg site-public/docs/ && cp scripts/ds-theme.css scripts/ds-showcase.css scripts/ds-scrollspy.js scripts/ds-showcase.js scripts/ds-dark-mode.js scripts/ds-config.js site-public/scripts/ && cp -R assets/. site-public/assets/ && cp examples/*.html site-public/examples/ && cp verification/*.html site-public/verification/
